# Vedara Care AI Documentation

Vedara Care is a DHA-licensed holistic healthcare polyclinic located in Jumeirah Village Circle (JVC), Dubai.
We offer comprehensive treatments including Ayurveda, Physiotherapy, Dermatology, Wellness, and Home Healthcare.

## Services
- Ayurveda: Authentic Kerala Ayurvedic treatments, Panchakarma, Abhyanga, Shirodhara.
- Physiotherapy: Manual therapy, sports injury rehab, post-surgery rehabilitation.
- Dermatology: Skin rejuvenation, chemical peels, acne treatments, hair loss treatments.
- Wellness: Cupping therapy, holistic wellness.
- Home Healthcare: Physiotherapy at home, licensed home therapies.
